name: Bikewo Green Tech Limited
summary: A substantial shift from vehicle retail to logistics services has improved reported operating profit, but accounting-control exceptions, uncertain target economics and very large optional warrant dilution prevent a cleared investment conclusion. The completed annual model pairs every capital receipt with its shares and explicitly funds fleet and software replacement.

sections.title: Executive Verdict
sections.text: Bikewo has delivered a substantial shift into services, but national EV adoption and strategic MoUs are not per-share cash earnings. The completed no-future-warrant reference gives terminal₹79.74/IRR-9.37% against₹123.50. Paired full exercise gives about ₹43.34, despite adding the remaining subscription cash, because share count also rises sharply. An optimistic no-exercise case reaches₹242.26/16.36%, while its full-exercise counterpart is about ₹101.29. Reliability and target-economics uncertainty prevent investment certification; annual modeling is complete. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S90]

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: BQS/GQS/IAS NS because REV and Q lack a comparable underlying-growth basis. All remaining factor contributions and raw missing-data bounds are retained. This supersedes the earlier unanchored REV4, not a gate-based deletion of otherwise complete arithmetic. No persistent cash/capital cap is applied. GOV 4, MOAT 3, DUR 5, CAP 4, CASH 3, BAL 5, EXEC 4 and EARN 4 are supported with contrary evidence. R 1/D 1/P 2/L 3 assess conditional model and implementation evidence. One-point CAP/CASH changes move known BQS contribution 0.22/GQS0.25; uncertain forecasts are not precise rankings. The software bridge is corrected substantively rather than preserving an old negative inference. [S1] [S3] [S90]

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Services rise from₹1.2662 crore to ₹48.9919 crore, while traded goods fall from₹22.2534 crore to ₹5.4980 crore. Retail, fleet deployment, logistics and institutional services have different revenue recognition, asset use and customer economics; this is not same-store EV retail growth. Mear Logistics LLP is an associate, not an omitted subsidiary. The September wholly owned subsidiary is a subsequent incorporation, not automatically an operating profit contributor. The model does not add target sales to group revenue or apply a whole-group minority haircut. [S1] [S6]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Network density, OEM relationships and fleet utilization could support useful economics, but no durable price premium, retention series or protected customer franchise was established. IPO materials found no direct listed peer. The June preferential valuer used Competent Automobiles, Updater Services and Kapston, mixing retail and facility-service models. NAV₹31.81 and earnings-capitalization₹23.71 were historical preferential-issue method outputs, not current targets or Ignitium fairness evidence. Explicit scenario exit EBIT multiples8/12/16× are assumptions, not a verified comparable-company median. [S2] [S7]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: IPO revenue FY2022/23/24 was₹13.806/20.5685/24.9878 crore, followed by₹23.5196 crore FY2025 and₹54.4899 crore FY2026. The latest 131.68% growth is real as reported, but services expand from a tiny base while goods contract sharply. A blended multiyear CAGR does not establish recurring service-demand growth on a consistent retained-value basis. No independent organic/acquired/price-volume bridge or mature service cohort was found. REV is therefore NS, replacing the earlier generic 4 rather than disguising incomparable growth with a low score. [S1] [S2]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: The Reliance contracts total₹66.46416 crore including GST through 31 July 2033 and explicitly qualify fulfillment as indicative; no guaranteed annual run rate is extracted. Evify’s 500-vehicle first phase and potential 10,000 scale-up require separate commercial/technical terms. Commerce Forever’s up-to 2,500 vehicles are phased. Enlite majority purchase remains conditional, warehousing is exploratory, and September 30 Moonrider tractor pilots require definitive agreements. These announcements support possible routes to market, not secured revenue or unmodeled free fleet. Ordinary model capex scales with service growth and includes replacement; speculative acquisitions and warehouses are excluded unless tested separately. [S5] [S8] [S9] [S11] [S12] [S14]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: The FY2026 auditor reports that the company did not maintain audit-trail functionality throughout the year. The consolidated changes-in-equity table reports closing share capital of ₹23.3912 crore, whereas the balance sheet and issued-share note support about ₹13.0433 crore; a complete reconciliation was not verified. The model therefore uses the issued-share record and subsequent actual allotment, not the inconsistent table. Separately, the software note explicitly matches ₹9.5981 crore additions to opening CWIP, so this is not treated as an unexplained transfer to the associate or evidence of diversion. These are specific accounting-control and presentation findings, not allegations of fraud. August 10 actual issuance, July CEO appointment and September advisory appointment are completed actions; experience is not proof of realized platform returns. Ignitium 29.43% for₹16.0425 crore cash was approved with a seven-working-day target, but closing confirmation and full target accounts were not verified. Its disclosed sales fall₹83.01 crore→₹70.7512 crore→₹49.7219 crore, latest unaudited. Approval of a minority stake is not consolidation of an earlier proposed majority transaction. The model assumes payment in the reference and supplies a not-closed alternative restoring cash and removing the investment. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S10] [S13]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: Group PAT₹3.2748 crore versus₹0.6578 crore improves materially. Strict operating EBIT₹4.7974 crore and EBITDA₹5.6578 crore exclude other income and the associate loss; parent PAT₹3.3122 crore explains printed EPS 2.54, whereas group profit implies about 2.51 on March shares. Reported CFO₹9.9229 crore contains₹4.2086 crore ST borrowing, yielding analyst borrowing-reclassified₹5.7143 crore. Prior-year−₹13.6731 crore plus₹5.8660 crore debt repayment gives−₹7.8071 crore; two-year conversion is about−0.532. FY2026 inventory release₹2.4248 crore and other-current-asset release₹3.2224 crore support cash, while AR absorbs₹4.6553 crore. After PPE₹3.9529 crore and LLP investment₹10.20 crore, reclassified cash is−₹8.4386 crore. These are analyst classifications, not corrected accounts. Software note2 explicitly shows₹9.5981 crore additions matching opening CWIP; it is not cash capex paid again or a Mear transfer. Historical capital return proxy 8.75% and incremental 22.92% include software/associate capital and do not prove mature fleet returns. [S1] [S2]

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: Reference service growth 20/18/15/12/10%, goods flat, margins 11%/4%, 35% net WC, 11% debt cost and 12× terminal EBIT are assumptions. Fleet growth capex is 12% of incremental service sales plus 15% of opening fleet book for maintenance. Software maintenance is 1% of service revenue with five-year cohort amortization; legacy software uses 10-year life with 6/3-year stresses. The three-year case funds replacement, avoiding a free expiry-related terminal profit jump. Actual equity/warrant downpayment₹20.185495 crore and 452,600 issued shares enter FY2027 once, less assumed 2% fees. Optional full exercise adds₹56.347305 crore and 24,235,400 shares together. Reference pays Ignitium₹16.0425 crore and values Mear/Ignitium only through separate cost-recovery sensitivities, not invented target profits. Current net tax₹0.8622 crore and gratuity₹0.0239 crore settle once;DTL₹0.3132 crore remains terminal. No separate NC employee liability is recognized in the inspected balance; future employee costs remain in margins. Base needs about ₹1.01 crore new credit and returns−9.37%. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S90]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Bear uses an initial 10% service decline, 7% service margin, 48% WC, AR/advance impairments, three-year legacy software replacement, low target recovery and 8× exit EBIT. Equity is exhausted despite₹14.43 crore conditional new borrowing. No-credit base/bear and a demand-loan call without replacement credit fail the cash floor; no shareholder IRR is assigned. Reference terminal falls to about ₹45.71 at 8% service margin,₹54.15 under three-year software replacement,₹64.03 at 25% fleet-growth capital intensity and₹67.06 if both investments recover zero. Full warrants plus a₹40 crore new investment recovering half produces about ₹38.09, showing why subscription cash is not an automatic return bonus. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S90]

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: The15% hurdle requires terminal₹229.90 over the actual holding clock. Without conversion, it requires about 51.49% annual service growth,₹396.40 crore terminal revenue,₹109.21 crore new debt and₹62.03 crore cash capex. Full conversion requires 85.80% growth, revenue₹1,090.27 crore, debt₹331.82 crore and capex₹166.15 crore. Fivefold/tenfold price outcomes without conversion require roughly 87.59%/116.26% annual service growth, with capex₹174.01/₹345.56 crore and debt₹409.94/₹891.30 crore. With full conversion, growth rises to 129.92%/165.08%, capex₹464.66/₹926.93 crore and debt₹1,158.77/₹2,505.96 crore. All cases fund growing fleet/software and WC, but customer demand, available finance and linear capital intensity remain assumptions. They do not establish multibagger feasibility. [S1] [S3] [S90]

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Obtain corrected equity/EPS presentation and independent audit-trail remediation. Verify service revenue recognition, customer concentration, utilization and collections rather than headline MoU vehicle counts. Track software commissioning/classification, useful life and actual replacement spend against the modeled schedule. Obtain Mear ownership, audited accounts and invested-capital recovery evidence; confirm Ignitium completion, target liabilities and profitability. Reconcile post-August cash, issue fees and every warrant exercise with shares. Track bank demand-loan headroom, current-tax settlement and new acquisition obligations. Confirm definitive contract economics and funding before including Enlite, warehousing, Evify expansion or tractor deployment. Refresh ESM, circuit rules and lot-sized depth. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S5] [S8] [S11] [S12] [S14] [S96]

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Completed full-model review, not a cleared platform-compounder investment. Genuine service growth is counterbalanced by an incomparable growth history, specific reliability issues, uncertain investment recovery and major optional dilution. Official 60-session mean/median values are₹8.282895 million/₹6.9113 million, giving illustrative₹5 lakh exit 1.447 days at 5%, 3.617 days at 2% and 0.723 days at 10%. Recent 20-session median₹4.4066 million gives 2.269 days at 5%. ESM Stage II, fewer than 100 PAN and only 5 latest trades justifyL 3 despite complete60-day observations. One lot costs₹247,000 and two₹494,000; that arithmetic does not guarantee an exit. [S90] [S91] [S92] [S95] [S96]

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Primary annual, IPO, actual-allotment, acquisition and subsequent September disclosures were read selectively. The software bridge was resolved from the actual note, while capital-table and receivable-note differences remain: BS AR₹14.9375 crore versus note₹14.9491 crore, a₹0.0116 crore gap. Model uses BS consistently. Mear and Ignitium recovery values are bounded equity-investment sensitivities, not full target valuations, because audited target claims/profits were not available. No-exercise and full-exercise paths are both disclosed; an in-the-money warrant may be economically attractive to exercise but is not a completed allotment. Proposed partnerships, live execution, financing access and future operating margins remain uncertain. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S11] [S14]

GOV.reason: Audit-trail and equity-presentation exceptions plus incomplete target-account detail constrain stewardship to 4. Contrary: actual financing and acquisition terms are disclosed, and the software bridge is resolved; no unsupported concealment or CWIP-diversion allegation remains.

MOAT.reason: Fleet density and customer relationships may help, but distribution/logistics economics remain contestable and announced collaborations are conditional. Actual service scale is contrary evidence against treating the business as nonexistent, not proof of protected pricing.

REV.reason: The old REV4 had no canonical CAGR anchor and is superseded. Retail collapses while services expand from a tiny one-year base; no sufficiently comparable multiyear demand/retained-value service series is established. Reported growth remains disclosed, but neither a generic low score nor an exceptional small-base score is substituted for missing comparable evidence.

DUR.reason: Existing logistics service demand and institutional relationships provide an accessible runway. Contrary: contracts are indicative and warehousing, Enlite, Evify scale-up and tractor applications require future definitive terms.5 reflects opportunity constrained by funding and execution.

CAP.reason: Historical CWIP/associate-inclusive normalized return around8.75% is modest, while latest incremental proxy22.92% improves from a low base. Software capitalization is now reconciled, but sustainable fleet/software returns and acquisition economics remain unproven. Mixed cohorts support4 rather than blanketNS.

CASH.reason: Two-year borrowing-reclassified operating cash is negative despiteFY2026 improvement; inventory and other-asset releases contribute to that recovery. Contrary: FY2026 adjusted cash is positive. CASH 3 is supported, but persistent-cap override is not assumed from this pair alone.

BAL.reason: Actual subscription cash funds much of the approved purchase; base only needs about 1.01 crore additional credit, while full conversion adds substantial liquidity. Contrary: no-exercise credit and demand-loan rollover remain conditional, bear needs 14.43 crore and new acquisitions may absorb funds.5 reflects mixed resilience, not free optional cash.

EXEC.reason: Service revenue was delivered and actual financing completed. Contrary: the enlarged acquisition/MoU portfolio has no demonstrated integrated profit/cash record. CEO/advisory experience is not company-level delivery proof.

EARN.reason: Core EBIT and EBITDA improve materially and associate loss is recognized. Resolved software transfer removes one prior unsupported concern, supporting4 rather than old3. Remaining normalization includes useful life, EPS scope, capital presentation and cash realization; it is not exceptional recurring profit quality.

R.reason: No-future-exercise base return−9.37% versus15% hurdle is far below the−10percentage-point threshold, R 1; full-exercise base is weaker. Optimistic no-exercise16.36% is not reference economics and paired full exercise removes that apparent spread. G2 still blocks IAS certification.

D.reason: Bear equity is exhausted after funding software replacement and working-capital losses; no-credit paths fail sooner. Contrary: actual cash and investment assets offer some recovery routes, but unverified target values do not establish severe-stress shareholder protection.

P.reason: The15% hurdle requires51.49% annual service growth without conversion or 85.80% with full exercise, with funded fleet/software and WC. Several strong operating and allocation assumptions must hold together, supporting2 rather than a cheap-platform thesis.

L.reason: 60-day capacity math starts in band 9 at 1.447 days, but recent20-day median is weaker at2.269 days. Downgrade to 3 for ESM Stage II, low-PAN concentration, latest5trades and₹247,000lot granularity. Two lots fit₹494,000, but fills/circuits/depth are not guaranteed; ST eligibility is not suspension.

Q.reason: BQS incomplete because comparable underlying growth is not established; no midpoint or renormalization.
